summary.en: argenx combines filed VYVGART expansions with major Phase 3 programmes in myositis, ITP and Graves’ disease, plus registrational Sjogren’s development. Empasiprubart and acquired FB102 broaden the immunology pipeline beyond FcRn.
summary.zh: argenx 将已申报的 VYVGART 适应症拓展与肌炎、ITP 和 Graves 病的重大 III 期项目相结合,并开展干燥综合征的注册性研究。Empasiprubart 和收购获得的 FB102 使免疫学管线拓展到 FcRn 之外。

ind.en: Ocular MG and paediatric gMG (US filed); IMNM/dermatomyositis, primary ITP and Graves’ disease (Phase 3); Sjogren’s disease (registrational)
ind.zh: 眼肌型 MG 和儿童 gMG(美国已申报);IMNM/皮肌炎、原发性 ITP 和 Graves 病(III 期);干燥综合征(注册性研究)

next.en: IMNM sBLA planned by year-end 2026; paediatric gMG FDA decision February 2027; ITP data 2027H1 and Sjogren data 2027H2
next.zh: 计划于 2026 年底前提交 IMNM sBLA;儿童 gMG 的 FDA 决定预计 2027 年 2 月作出;ITP 数据预计 2027 年上半年公布,干燥综合征数据预计 2027 年下半年公布

ind.en: Spinal muscular atrophy; congenital myasthenic syndromes
ind.zh: 脊髓性肌萎缩症;先天性肌无力综合征

watch.en: VYVGART Hytrulo IMNM filing is planned by year-end 2026; an additional registrational DM study is planned.
watch.zh: VYVGART Hytrulo 的 IMNM 申报计划于 2026 年底前完成;另计划开展一项 DM 注册性研究。

watch.en: Empasiprubart MMN data are expected December 2026; CIDP data in 2027H2.
watch.zh: Empasiprubart 的 MMN 数据预计 2026 年 12 月公布;CIDP 数据预计 2027 年下半年公布。

watch.en: VYVGART remains the commercial foundation while several new indications undergo registration or Phase 3 testing.
watch.zh: VYVGART 仍是商业化基石,同时多个新适应症正处于注册或 III 期试验阶段。

watch.en: The Forte acquisition added anti-CD122 antibody FB102; positive Phase 2 celiac results support planned Phase 3 advancement.
watch.zh: 收购 Forte 带来了抗 CD122 抗体 FB102;乳糜泻 II 期结果积极,支持其计划推进至 III 期。

sources: ARGX-118 antibody and academic discovery collaboration

gaps: Phase-by-phase company totals were not verified; counts is null. The interactive pipeline rendered no results in the browser; its downloadable chart and dated filings were also reviewed.

Efgartigimod is represented once, combining the filed oMG/paediatric gMG uses with major Phase 3/registrational new indications. IMNM filing and paediatric review dates follow Q3 results; Sjogren UNITY timing follows the half-year filing, without a newer verified forecast.

Primary ITP is already approved in Japan, but the selected ADVANCE-NEXT development concerns further registration. No new item is created for an already approved adult gMG/CIDP use or delivery-device change. The February 2027 FDA date concerns paediatric gMG, not ocular MG.
The January 2026 corporate presentation predates 2026-06 and is used only for ARGX-121 antibody modality; Phase 2 status follows the October update.
Efgartigimod is an engineered Fc fragment, represented as other rather than a full antibody; company descriptions of its FcRn mechanism and current filings remain unchanged.
